summary: Manhattan Bridge Capital filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing that its board approved expanding its existing share buyback program from 100,000 to 250,000 common shares and extended the program for an additional 12 months from the October 9, 2026 board approval. Repurchases may occur via open market, privately negotiated or other transactions, with no obligation to buy. No price, premium or advisor was disclosed; the authorization is discretionary and terminable by the board. Watch execution pace, liquidity and any signal on the REIT's loan-book valuation.
